_source: supabase/auth internal/mailer/templatemailer/templatemailer.go: defaultTemplateSubjects and defaultTemplateBodies. since_v2_190_0 is main at 10ef10789d1e (read 23 Nov 2026; the copy changed in 305c1bf, #2517, released in v2.190.0); before_v2_190_0 is cda62a9c215e, the commit before it. An empty mailer_subjects_<type> or mailer_templates_<type>_content sends these.

subjects.identity_linked_notification: A new sign-in method was linked to your account
subjects.identity_unlinked_notification: A sign-in method was removed from your account
subjects.mfa_factor_enrolled_notification: A new verification method was added to your account
subjects.mfa_factor_unenrolled_notification: A verification method was removed from your account

bodies.invite:

Accept invitation

Confirm your email address

bodies.recovery:
Reset your password

We received a request to reset your password. Follow the link below to choose a new one.

Reset password

If you didn't request this, you can safely ignore this email.

Your sign-in link

Follow the link below to sign in. This link expires shortly and can only be used once.

The password for your account was recently changed.
